Applicant is apprehending arrest in Crime No.31 of 2020 registered with Kalwa Police Station Anti Narcotic Cell, Thane for the ofences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Section 26(2), 27, 26(2)(IV), 30(2)(A) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: Kalwa Police Station Anti Narcotic Cell, Thane
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On 22nd January, 2020, three vehicles were intercepted at Kharegaon toll naka at Thane wherein the alleged gutkha products were found.

One Mr. Sanket Sangle,
co-accused had claimed ownership of the material found in the vehicles.
It is the prosecution's case that applicant was to receive the delivery of the said goods.
4 It may be stated that except ofence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC, all ofences are bailable in nature.

The learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the judgment in the case of Anand Ramdhani Chaurasia & Anr. v.
State of Maharashtra & Ors. Dated 8th August, 2019 (in Writ Petition No.3607 of 2019)

entities.text:
Anand Ramdhani Chaurasia & Anr. v.
State of Maharashtra & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: wherein it is observed that the ofence under Section 328 of IPC is not attracted in such cases.

5 The learned APP informs that similar issue is raised in the other matters and it would be appropriate to hear the Abdullah Hisamuddin Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 18 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96581761/
1 applications together.

entities.text: Abdullah Hisamuddin Khan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 18 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6 Hence, the following order:
906-ABA-397- 2020.odt

(I) In the event of arrest of the applicant in Crime No. I-31 of 2020 registered with Kalwa Police Station Anti Narcotic Cell Thane, he shall be released on executing PR bond for the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in like sum;
(ii) This interim protection is granted till the next date of hearing;

entities.text: Kalwa Police Station Anti Narcotic Cell Thane
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
(iii) Stand over to 24th March, 2020. To be listed along with Anticipatory Bail Application Nos.2384, 2194 and 2558 of 2019.
(SANDEEP K. SHINDE, J.)
